import os
import random
import hashlib
import subprocess
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk
from datetime import datetime

import qrcode

from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, Image
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

# -------------------------
# MAIN WINDOW
# -------------------------

root = tk.Tk()
root.title("Secure Data Wiping Tool")
root.geometry("650x640")
root.configure(bg="#1e1e1e")

# -------------------------
# SECURITY STATUS
# -------------------------

status = tk.Label(
    root,
    text="Security Status: Protected",
    fg="#00ff9c",
    bg="#1e1e1e",
    font=("Segoe UI",12,"bold")
)
status.pack(pady=10)

# -------------------------
# PROGRESS BAR
# -------------------------

progress = ttk.Progressbar(root, length=420, mode="determinate")
progress.pack(pady=10)

# -------------------------
# LOG FILE
# -------------------------

log_file = "wipe_log.txt"

def log_action(text):

    with open(log_file,"a") as f:
        f.write(f"{datetime.now()} - {text}\n")

# -------------------------
# SHA256 HASH
# -------------------------

def generate_hash():

    sha = hashlib.sha256()

    with open(log_file,"rb") as f:
        while True:

            data = f.read(4096)

            if not data:
                break

            sha.update(data)

    return sha.hexdigest()

# -------------------------
# QR CODE
# -------------------------

def generate_qr(data):

    img = qrcode.make(data)

    qr_file = "hash_qr.png"
    img.save(qr_file)

    return qr_file

# -------------------------
# OPENSSL SIGNATURE
# -------------------------

def sign_log():

    signature = "log_signature.sig"

    try:

        subprocess.run([
            "openssl",
            "dgst",
            "-sha256",
            "-sign",
            "private.pem",
            "-out",
            signature,
            log_file
        ])

    except:
        pass

# -------------------------
# WIPE FILE
# -------------------------

def wipe_file(path):

    try:

        size = os.path.getsize(path)

        with open(path,"wb") as f:
            f.write(os.urandom(size))

        os.remove(path)

        log_action(f"Wiped file: {path}")

    except Exception as e:
        messagebox.showerror("Error",str(e))

# -------------------------
# WIPE FILE BUTTON
# -------------------------

def select_file():

    file_path = filedialog.askopenfilename()

    if not file_path:
        return

    progress["value"] = 0
    root.update()

    wipe_file(file_path)

    progress["value"] = 100

    messagebox.showinfo("Success","File wiped successfully")

# -------------------------
# WIPE FOLDER
# -------------------------

def select_folder():

    folder = filedialog.askdirectory()

    if not folder:
        return

    files = []

    for r,d,f in os.walk(folder):
        for file in f:
            files.append(os.path.join(r,file))

    total = len(files)

    if total == 0:
        return

    for i,file in enumerate(files):

        wipe_file(file)

        percent = ((i+1)/total)*100
        progress["value"] = percent
        root.update()

    messagebox.showinfo("Completed","Folder wiped successfully")

# -------------------------
# SCAN SENSITIVE FILES
# -------------------------

def scan_files():

    folder = filedialog.askdirectory()

    if not folder:
        return

    sensitive = [".pdf",".docx",".xlsx",".txt",".csv"]

    count = 0

    for r,d,f in os.walk(folder):

        for file in f:

            if any(file.lower().endswith(x) for x in sensitive):
                count += 1

    messagebox.showinfo("Scan Result",f"{count} sensitive files found")

# -------------------------
# RECOVERY TEST
# -------------------------

def recovery_test():

    chance = random.randint(0,10)

    messagebox.showinfo(
        "Recovery Simulation",
        f"Recovery chance after secure wipe: {chance}%"
    )

# -------------------------
# EXPORT PDF CERTIFICATE
# -------------------------

def export_pdf():

    if not os.path.exists(log_file):

        messagebox.showwarning("Warning","No log found")
        return

    hash_value = generate_hash()

    qr_file = generate_qr(hash_value)

    sign_log()

    pdf_file = "wipe_certificate.pdf"

    styles = getSampleStyleSheet()

    elements = []

    elements.append(Paragraph("Secure Data Wipe Certificate",styles["Title"]))
    elements.append(Spacer(1,20))

    elements.append(Paragraph("Log Entries:",styles["Heading2"]))
    elements.append(Spacer(1,10))

    with open(log_file) as f:

        for line in f:
            elements.append(Paragraph(line,styles["Normal"]))
            elements.append(Spacer(1,4))

    elements.append(Spacer(1,20))

    elements.append(Paragraph("SHA256 Hash:",styles["Heading2"]))
    elements.append(Paragraph(hash_value,styles["Normal"]))

    elements.append(Spacer(1,20))

    elements.append(Paragraph("Verification QR Code:",styles["Heading2"]))
    elements.append(Image(qr_file,width=120,height=120))

    doc = SimpleDocTemplate(pdf_file)
    doc.build(elements)

    messagebox.showinfo("PDF Created","wipe_certificate.pdf generated")

# -------------------------
# CLEAR LOG
# -------------------------

def clear_log():

    if os.path.exists(log_file):
        os.remove(log_file)

    messagebox.showinfo("Log","Log cleared")

# -------------------------
# BUTTONS
# -------------------------

frame = tk.Frame(root,bg="#1e1e1e")
frame.pack(pady=20)

buttons = [

("Wipe File","#0078D7",select_file),
("Wipe Folder","#2ecc71",select_folder),
("Scan Sensitive Files","#f39c12",scan_files),
("Recovery Simulation","#9b59b6",recovery_test),
("Download PDF Certificate","#e74c3c",export_pdf),
("Clear Log","#555555",clear_log)

]

for text,color,cmd in buttons:

    b = tk.Button(
        frame,
        text=text,
        width=30,
        bg=color,
        fg="white",
        command=cmd
    )

    b.pack(pady=4)

root.mainloop()
